body:
Clarification from the user who raised this: the real scenario is **a photo of the invoice sent to the AI in a chat app**. There the client has no bytes to forward, so option B does not help this user at all; only A (one link, several photos picked from the phone album at once) reduces their steps. This strengthens the recommendation for A and leaves B for agents with local file access only.

Not yet measured: a phone photo (JPEG) through the link (the PDF path is measured). The field's `accept` list has no `.heic`; iOS usually converts to JPEG when a browser file input picks from Photos, but that is unverified here.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Measured for option B (2026-11-12, same tenant): an agent running on the user's machine with the invoice photo as a local file (JPEG). It reads the photo (amount ¥268.00, meal, invoice number), files the claim over MCP (`create_record` → draft with amount 268), and then has no way to attach the photo: no MCP tool takes file content, and the same MCP OAuth token on `POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned` answers `401 AUTH_REQUIRED` (correct — the token is bound to the MCP resource). Its only route is an upload link, so the user re-picks a file the agent already holds.

So the business pull for B is real for local agents (Claude Code, desktop agents), not hypothetical. Updated recommendation: **A now, B next**, B with the provenance mark (added by an AI client, which client), the size cap, and the same edit-door check as the link. The forged-file concern is unchanged and is the reason B carries the mark rather than being refused.

## 分诊首触 + 决策分析(fable 档独立评估)· 2026-11-12T16:55Z

**维护者速读**
- 3 张发票要发 3 个链接、选 3 次。
- ① 一个链接一次选多个文件:沿用您已裁的「须登录的链接」通道。
- ② agent 直接交文件内容(base64):这是一道新的写入门,agent 能放上用户没亲手选的文件,比如伪造的发票。
- 建议这次只裁 ①。请裁:**A 一链多文件 / B A + agent 直传 / C 不做**。推荐 A。

**是否已有裁决:**
- ① 未找到。
- ② 在 #30892 的 Ask 3 里是「暂缓」(要等客户端能发送文件内容),不是否决;条件部分满足,但不等于授权。

**前提核实:**
- 一条 pending `sys_file` 行对应一个链接、一个文件。A 要改已评审过的「单次使用」条件,工作量比卡上写的 1 个 PR 高。
- 第一方 `multiple: true` 的文件字段为 0。

| 选项 | 客户看到 | 工作量 |
|---|---|---|
| **A 多文件字段的链接一次收多个(同一用户、记录、字段,设上限)** | 打开链接一次选 3 张发票 | storage · 1–2 个 PR + 契约评审;先例 #31009 |
| B A + `attach_file`(base64) | 本地 agent 直接挂上;聊天软件里发照片的场景无益 | 2 个以上 PR;无先例;新写入面 |
| C 不做 | 一个文件一个链接 | 0 |

**四轴:**
- ① 长远:一次请求多个文件是通行做法;B 的来源真实性问题对财务凭证很重。
- ② 拉动:多张发票是常态。
- ③ 防 AI:A 仍由人选文件;B 的来源标记只是事后披露。
- ④ 不扩散:A 改现有门,B 新增工具和标记。

**推荐 A**,与 #32686 合成一次设计。置信缺口:手机相册 HEIC 格式未实测;上限数值待定。**自检:** 只看①选 A;不翻转。人工底线项:B(新写入门)。

os-decision-facets
- ① 长远:沿用已裁的须登录链接,只放宽容量;B 的来源真实性未解
- ② 拉动:多张发票常见(实测 2 张发票用了 2 个链接);B 只利好本地 agent
- ③ 防 AI:A 由人选文件;B 让 agent 能写入用户没选的字节
- ④ 不扩散:A 改现有门,须契约评审;B 新增工具与标记,暂缓

Prior rulings read: #30892 ruling B and its Ask 3 (deferred, not refused); ADR-0104 D3; thread: 2 comments, no ruling

## More reach for ② (agent holds the bytes) — and a case on a child-table file field · 2026-11-13T03:05Z

Measured on the `os-dev-test` environment today, with a third-party local agent (WorkBuddy; models DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash / GLM-5.3-Flash) operating an OA app over MCP for its user.

**The case.** The user handed the agent two invoice PDFs for a travel expense claim. The app models the claim as a header (`c982_expense_claim`) with line items (`c982_expense_item`, `master_detail` → claim); the invoice is a `file` field **on each line item**, one invoice per line, so the approver checks each amount against its own invoice.

- The agent read both PDFs (amounts ¥329.00 / ¥277.00, order numbers, invoice numbers), rebuilt the claim and its two lines over MCP — all fields filled.
- It also hashed the files and noticed that two of the user's files for one invoice were the same file (MD5 equal), so it de-duplicated before filing. **It holds the bytes.**
- To attach them it can only call `create_upload_link` once per line item → two links, each bound to one child record + field, ~10 minutes. It then told the user: 「我这边的 OA 连接没有『直接推送文件』的能力……链接必须在你自己登录 OA 的浏览器里打开,选择本地 PDF 上传」. The user re-picks two files the agent already has, one link per line.

**Two things this adds to the card.**

1. **Option A does not help this shape.** A is "one link takes several files on a `multiple: true` field". Here each invoice belongs to a *different child record*, so it is still one link per line no matter how many files a link accepts. N line items = N links = N re-picks. Only B (an agent that holds the bytes hands them over) removes the round trip for line-item attachments, which is the normal shape of an expense claim.
2. **Ordering trap with approvals.** The app locks line items while the claim's approval is pending (a validation reading `record.claim.approval_status`, so the approver reviews exactly what was submitted). The agent had to stop and ask the user to upload *before* submitting — "一旦提交进入审批中,明细会被锁定,发票就传不进去了". With links that expire in minutes and a human in the loop, a missed upload means recall → upload → resubmit (and recall is itself not available to agents yet, #32993).

Neither changes the security concern triage raised for B (an agent can attach a file the user never picked). It does mean the business pull for B covers local agents on master–detail forms, where A gives no relief.
